cohort: Laboring women in California community hospitals with and without laborists
finding: There were no differences in cesarean and maternal childbirth complication rates in community hospitals with and without laborists, after adjusting for patient and hospital characteristics.
mod_finding: Hospitals with laborists had higher attempted trial of labor after cesarean rates, and lower repeat cesarean rates, but among women attempting trial of labor after cesarean, there was no difference in the vaginal birth after cesarean success rate.
